title: PFRDA Master Regulations on NPS Tier I and Tier II Architecture
source: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
content: PFRDA regulates the National Pension System (NPS) comprising two account tiers: Tier I is the mandatory primary retirement pension account with withdrawal restrictions until age 60. Tier II is a voluntary liquid savings account accessible only if a Tier I account is active. Subscribers choose investment allocation via Active Choice (up to 75% equity) or Auto Choice (lifecycle funds adjusting equity-debt ratio automatically based on age).
